capabilityInventory.description: Records the capability decomposition and catalog searches that informed this decision. Required (non-null) for reference, adopt, and substitute modes; a null value or absence means the decision was made without a capability inventory and is not authoritative for a governed mode.

directQuery.description: The original product-level query or brief phrase searched against the catalog.

directQueryResults.description: Number of catalog entries the directQuery returned. Zero against a populated capability inventory is inconclusive, not exhaustion.

searchedCapabilities.description: Canonical capability names decomposed from the brief and searched.

capabilityResults.description: Per-capability search outcomes keyed by canonical capability name.

terms.description: Search terms used for this capability.

count.description: Number of catalog entries found for this capability.

matchedIds.description: Catalog entry ids matched for this capability.

zeroResultInconclusive.description: True when directQueryResults is 0 but at least one capabilityResults entry has count > 0; the product-level miss is not treated as catalog exhaustion.
